items.q: How did Germans view the Treaty of Versailles?
items.correct: As a harsh 'diktat' (war guilt, reparations, lost land) that caused deep resentment.
items.misconception: As a fair settlement they accepted willingly.
items.why: Resentment at Versailles was exploited by extremists, including the Nazis.

items.q: Did the League of Nations successfully prevent war?
items.correct: It had some successes but failed to stop aggression in the 1930s (Manchuria, Abyssinia).
items.why: Lacking key members and an army, the League couldn't curb aggressive states.

items.q: Did WWII begin suddenly with no warning?
items.correct: No — appeasement and steps like the Rhineland, Anschluss and Sudetenland preceded it.
items.misconception: Yes, it began out of nowhere.
items.random_wrong: It began with the bombing of Pearl Harbor.
items.why: War in Europe followed years of escalating aggression, beginning with Poland in 1939.
